Title: Top-Ranked Cars, Trucks and SUVs in the J.D. Power 2014 APEAL Study

The annual _J.D. Power U.S. Automotive Performance, Execution, and Layout (APEAL) Study__SM_ measures how gratifying new vehicles are to own and drive after 90 days of ownership. In other words, it determines a vehicle's overall appeal. Based on the results of the _2014 APEAL Study_, the following models receive an award for ranking at the top of their respective vehicle segments. The award recipients are displayed in alphabetical order by make and model.
**2014 Audi A8**
This year, in the Large Premium Car segment, the Audi A8 ties with the completely redesigned Mercedes-Benz S-Class. For 2014, the A8 lineup expanded with the addition of the 3.0 TDI turbo-diesel model, and Audi installed additional standard features while making 22-way power ventilated front seats, ventilated rear seats, and massaging rear seats more widely available.
**2014 Audi Q5**
Leading the Compact Premium SUV segment, the Audi Q5 lineup expanded for 2014 to include a new TDI turbo-diesel model designed to get up to 31 mpg and a performance-oriented SQ5 variant equipped with a 354-horsepower, supercharged V-6 engine.
**2014 BMW 4 Series**
New for 2014 and offered in coupe and convertible body styles, the BMW 4 Series is based on the 3 Series and effectively replaces the previous 3 Series coupe and convertible models. Available as the 428i and 435i with rear-wheel or all-wheel drive, the 4 Series is the most appealing Compact Premium Car in this year's _APEAL Study_.
**2014 Dodge Challenger**
Among owners of Midsize Sporty Cars, those who buy the Dodge Challenger rate it the most appealing model, ahead of the Chevrolet Camaro and Ford Mustang. In 2014, Dodge offered new Hemi-powered Shaker models, additional limited-production variants, and new Scat Pack performance upgrades that don't void the factory warranty.
**2014 Dodge Charger**

In the Large Car segment, the Dodge Charger ranks highest, ahead of the Chevrolet SS and Kia Cadenza. Changes for 2014 included a new Charger Sport model with all-wheel drive, new Redline package, and expanded availability of big wheels and tires and a sport suspension to less-expensive versions.
**2014 Dodge Dart**
In the Compact Car segment of the _2014 APEAL Study_, the Dodge Dart is ranked highest. For 2014, Dodge replaced last year's turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and dual-clutch automated manual transmission on all Dart models, except the fuel-efficient Aero version, with a more conventional 4-cylinder and automatic transmission. Dodge also simplified the Dart lineup and the method buyers use to option the car.
**2014 Ford F-150**
In its final year before a redesign that includes an all-aluminum body, the Ford F-150 is the most appealing Large Light Duty Pickup in this year's _APEAL Study_. Aside from the debut of a turbocharged Tremor performance model, few changes were made to the 2014 F-150.
**2014 Ford F-Series Super Duty**
Among Large Heavy Duty Pickup trucks, the F-Series Super Duty lineup receives an award for overall vehicle appeal. For 2014, towing and payload capacity increased, thanks to a revamped braking system.
**2014 GMC Yukon**
The 2014 GMC Yukon is named the most appealing Large SUV, just before a redesigned 2015 model arrived in showrooms. Aside from adding more standard equipment to the base model, the only change was the addition of a new paint color.
**2014 Honda Ridgeline**
Honda is working on a redesigned Ridgeline, due for the 2016 model year. In the meantime, buyers of the old truck like it well enough that the Ridgeline ranks higher than the Nissan Frontier and Toyota Tacoma among Midsize Pickup models. For 2014, Honda added a new SE trim level at the top of the lineup.
**2014 Hyundai Accent**

The entry-level Accent is the most appealing Small Car in the _J.D. Power 2014 APEAL Study_, ranked higher than the Ford Fiesta and Chevrolet Sonic. For 2014, Hyundai added standard features, improved the car's voice-recognition Bluetooth system, and installed new upgrades for upper trim levels.
**2014 Kia Soul**
Redesigned for 2014, the Kia Soul is the highest-ranked Compact Multi-Purpose Vehicle in terms of appeal. Larger and more refined than it was before, the latest version of the Soul offers modern technology and practicality wrapped up in a unique package.
**2014 Land Rover Range Rover**
Among the most appealing models regardless of price, the Land Rover Range Rover is the highest-ranked model in the Large Premium SUV category in the _2014 APEAL Study_. This year, a new supercharged V-6 engine replaced last year's standard V-8 engine, LED headlights are standard, adaptive cruise control is less expensive, and Autobiography models gained equipment.
**2014 Mazda 6**
Redesigned this year, the Mazda 6 is the most appealing Midsize Car for 2014, ahead of the Kia Optima and Hyundai Sonata. Offered only with a 4-cylinder engine, the Mazda 6 can be optioned with several technologies commonly available only on more expensive vehicles.
**2014 Mercedes-Benz CLS-Class**
Among Midsize Premium Cars, the Mercedes-Benz CLS-Class ranks as the most appealing model, ahead of the Audi A7 and Audi A6. For 2014, Mercedes added 4Matic all-wheel drive as standard equipment for the performance-tuned CLS63 AMG, and debuted a higher-performance CLS63 AMG S-Model.
**2014 Mercedes-Benz S-Class**
Completely redesigned, the 2014 S-Class ties with the Audi A8 as the most appealing Large Premium Car in the latest _J.D. Power APEAL Study_. Four variants, including two high-performance AMG models, range in price from $94,000 to $222,000. Next-generation infotainment and autonomous safety technologies highlight the newest family of S-Class models.
**2014 Mini Countryman**

Ranking higher than the Buick Encore and Volkswagen Tiguan, the Mini Countryman is the most appealing Small SUV in the _2014 APEAL Study_. New John Cooper Works appearance packages debuted this past year, and Mini made minor equipment changes, including the addition of a standard 3-passenger rear bench seat, replacing the previous bucket seats.
**2014 Nissan Quest**
According to the _2014 APEAL Study_, Nissan Quest owners like their minivans, and this model ranks higher than the popular Honda Odyssey and Toyota Sienna for overall appeal in 2014. Aside from new colors, no changes were made this year.
**2014 Nissan Rogue**
Completely redesigned, the 2014 Nissan Rogue receives an award for ranking highest among Compact SUVs in the _2014 APEAL Study_, ahead of the Ford Escape and Jeep Cherokee. It is one of two models in its class to offer 7-passenger seating, and is available with numerous infotainment and safety technologies.
**2014 Porsche 911**
The multitude of Porsche 911 variants collectively ranks highest for vehicle appeal among Midsize Premium Sporty Cars. This year, Targa, Turbo, and GT3 versions joined the 911 lineup.
**2014 Porsche Boxster**
The Porsche Boxster ranks higher than the Porsche Cayman and Nissan 370Z among Compact Premium Sporty Cars in the _J.D. Power 2014 APEAL Study_. One year following a complete redesign, the Boxster received few changes.
**2014 Porsche Cayenne**
Among Premium Midsize SUVs, the Porsche Cayenne ranks higher than do the BMW X5 and redesigned Land Rover Range Rover Sport. For 2014, a new Platinum Edition debuted at the lower end of the range while a high-performance Turbo S variant arrived as a range-topping flagship model.
**2014 Toyota Highlander**
Redesigned for 2014, the Toyota Highlander is the highest-ranked Midsize SUV in the _2014 APEAL Study_, followed by the Jeep Grand Cherokee and Dodge Durango. The Highlander offers seating for up to 8 people, and a choice between a 4-cylinder, V-6, or gas-electric hybrid powertrains.

**2014 Volkswagen GTI**
Compact Sporty Car buyers rate their Volkswagen GTIs higher in terms of appeal than do people purchasing the Hyundai Veloster and Mini Cooper. In advance of a redesigned 2015 model, the 2014 GTI was offered only as a 5-door hatchback.

The annual _J.D. Power U.S. Automotive Performance, Execution, and Layout (APEAL) Study__SM_ measures how gratifying new vehicles are to own and drive after 90 days of ownership. In other words, it determines a vehicle's overall appeal. Based on the results of the _2014 APEAL Study_, the following models receive an award for ranking at the top of their respective vehicle segments. The award recipients are displayed in alphabetical order by make and model.
**2014 Audi A8**
This year, in the Large Premium Car segment, the Audi A8 ties with the completely redesigned Mercedes-Benz S-Class. For 2014, the A8 lineup expanded with the addition of the 3.0 TDI turbo-diesel model, and Audi installed additional standard features while making 22-way power ventilated front seats, ventilated rear seats, and massaging rear seats more widely available.
**2014 Audi Q5**
Leading the Compact Premium SUV segment, the Audi Q5 lineup expanded for 2014 to include a new TDI turbo-diesel model designed to get up to 31 mpg and a performance-oriented SQ5 variant equipped with a 354-horsepower, supercharged V-6 engine.
**2014 BMW 4 Series**
New for 2014 and offered in coupe and convertible body styles, the BMW 4 Series is based on the 3 Series and effectively replaces the previous 3 Series coupe and convertible models. Available as the 428i and 435i with rear-wheel or all-wheel drive, the 4 Series is the most appealing Compact Premium Car in this year's _APEAL Study_.
**2014 Dodge Challenger**
Among owners of Midsize Sporty Cars, those who buy the Dodge Challenger rate it the most appealing model, ahead of the Chevrolet Camaro and Ford Mustang. In 2014, Dodge offered new Hemi-powered Shaker models, additional limited-production variants, and new Scat Pack performance upgrades that don't void the factory warranty.
**2014 Dodge Charger**
texts.1:
In the Large Car segment, the Dodge Charger ranks highest, ahead of the Chevrolet SS and Kia Cadenza. Changes for 2014 included a new Charger Sport model with all-wheel drive, new Redline package, and expanded availability of big wheels and tires and a sport suspension to less-expensive versions.
**2014 Dodge Dart**
In the Compact Car segment of the _2014 APEAL Study_, the Dodge Dart is ranked highest. For 2014, Dodge replaced last year's turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and dual-clutch automated manual transmission on all Dart models, except the fuel-efficient Aero version, with a more conventional 4-cylinder and automatic transmission. Dodge also simplified the Dart lineup and the method buyers use to option the car.
**2014 Ford F-150**
In its final year before a redesign that includes an all-aluminum body, the Ford F-150 is the most appealing Large Light Duty Pickup in this year's _APEAL Study_. Aside from the debut of a turbocharged Tremor performance model, few changes were made to the 2014 F-150.
**2014 Ford F-Series Super Duty**
Among Large Heavy Duty Pickup trucks, the F-Series Super Duty lineup receives an award for overall vehicle appeal. For 2014, towing and payload capacity increased, thanks to a revamped braking system.
**2014 GMC Yukon**
The 2014 GMC Yukon is named the most appealing Large SUV, just before a redesigned 2015 model arrived in showrooms. Aside from adding more standard equipment to the base model, the only change was the addition of a new paint color.
**2014 Honda Ridgeline**
Honda is working on a redesigned Ridgeline, due for the 2016 model year. In the meantime, buyers of the old truck like it well enough that the Ridgeline ranks higher than the Nissan Frontier and Toyota Tacoma among Midsize Pickup models. For 2014, Honda added a new SE trim level at the top of the lineup.
**2014 Hyundai Accent**
texts.2:
The entry-level Accent is the most appealing Small Car in the _J.D. Power 2014 APEAL Study_, ranked higher than the Ford Fiesta and Chevrolet Sonic. For 2014, Hyundai added standard features, improved the car's voice-recognition Bluetooth system, and installed new upgrades for upper trim levels.
**2014 Kia Soul**
Redesigned for 2014, the Kia Soul is the highest-ranked Compact Multi-Purpose Vehicle in terms of appeal. Larger and more refined than it was before, the latest version of the Soul offers modern technology and practicality wrapped up in a unique package.
**2014 Land Rover Range Rover**
Among the most appealing models regardless of price, the Land Rover Range Rover is the highest-ranked model in the Large Premium SUV category in the _2014 APEAL Study_. This year, a new supercharged V-6 engine replaced last year's standard V-8 engine, LED headlights are standard, adaptive cruise control is less expensive, and Autobiography models gained equipment.
**2014 Mazda 6**
Redesigned this year, the Mazda 6 is the most appealing Midsize Car for 2014, ahead of the Kia Optima and Hyundai Sonata. Offered only with a 4-cylinder engine, the Mazda 6 can be optioned with several technologies commonly available only on more expensive vehicles.
**2014 Mercedes-Benz CLS-Class**
Among Midsize Premium Cars, the Mercedes-Benz CLS-Class ranks as the most appealing model, ahead of the Audi A7 and Audi A6. For 2014, Mercedes added 4Matic all-wheel drive as standard equipment for the performance-tuned CLS63 AMG, and debuted a higher-performance CLS63 AMG S-Model.
**2014 Mercedes-Benz S-Class**
Completely redesigned, the 2014 S-Class ties with the Audi A8 as the most appealing Large Premium Car in the latest _J.D. Power APEAL Study_. Four variants, including two high-performance AMG models, range in price from $94,000 to $222,000. Next-generation infotainment and autonomous safety technologies highlight the newest family of S-Class models.
**2014 Mini Countryman**
texts.3:
Ranking higher than the Buick Encore and Volkswagen Tiguan, the Mini Countryman is the most appealing Small SUV in the _2014 APEAL Study_. New John Cooper Works appearance packages debuted this past year, and Mini made minor equipment changes, including the addition of a standard 3-passenger rear bench seat, replacing the previous bucket seats.
**2014 Nissan Quest**
According to the _2014 APEAL Study_, Nissan Quest owners like their minivans, and this model ranks higher than the popular Honda Odyssey and Toyota Sienna for overall appeal in 2014. Aside from new colors, no changes were made this year.
**2014 Nissan Rogue**
Completely redesigned, the 2014 Nissan Rogue receives an award for ranking highest among Compact SUVs in the _2014 APEAL Study_, ahead of the Ford Escape and Jeep Cherokee. It is one of two models in its class to offer 7-passenger seating, and is available with numerous infotainment and safety technologies.
**2014 Porsche 911**
The multitude of Porsche 911 variants collectively ranks highest for vehicle appeal among Midsize Premium Sporty Cars. This year, Targa, Turbo, and GT3 versions joined the 911 lineup.
**2014 Porsche Boxster**
The Porsche Boxster ranks higher than the Porsche Cayman and Nissan 370Z among Compact Premium Sporty Cars in the _J.D. Power 2014 APEAL Study_. One year following a complete redesign, the Boxster received few changes.
**2014 Porsche Cayenne**
Among Premium Midsize SUVs, the Porsche Cayenne ranks higher than do the BMW X5 and redesigned Land Rover Range Rover Sport. For 2014, a new Platinum Edition debuted at the lower end of the range while a high-performance Turbo S variant arrived as a range-topping flagship model.
**2014 Toyota Highlander**
Redesigned for 2014, the Toyota Highlander is the highest-ranked Midsize SUV in the _2014 APEAL Study_, followed by the Jeep Grand Cherokee and Dodge Durango. The Highlander offers seating for up to 8 people, and a choice between a 4-cylinder, V-6, or gas-electric hybrid powertrains.

##
Trick-or-treating is one of the best Halloween traditions. And whether you're a kid or an adult, there's no doubt you eat a few sweets on the spooky holiday. Instead of dishing out store-bought bags of treats this year, these homemade Halloween-themed candies will spice up all of your holiday festivities.
**Peanut Butter Pumpkins**
_What You'll Need:_
*   1/2 cup butter  
*   1 package confectioners' sugar (16 ounces)  
*   1 1/2 cups peanut butter  
*   yellow food coloring  
*   red food coloring  
*   green decorators' icing
_Cooking Instructions:_
1.   Melt the butter in a bowl, then add a few drops of red and yellow food coloring. It should turn to an orange (or pumpkin) color.  
2.   Stir the peanut butter and sugar into the bowl until the mixture is dough-like.  
3.   Roll the dough into bite-size, pumpkin-shaped balls, then use a toothpick to make ridges in them.  
4.   Add a drop of green icing to the top of your pumpkins to imitate a stem.  
5.   Refrigerate your pumpkins until firm.
**Halloween Caramel Corn**
_What You'll Need:_
*   16 cups popped popcorn  
*   1 cup butter  
*   5 cups miniature pretzels  
*   2 cups brown sugar  
*   1/2 cup dark corn syrup  
*   1/2 teaspoon salt  
*   1/2 teaspoon baking soda  
*   1 cup candy corn  
*   1 cup salted peanuts  
*   1 M&Ms
_Cooking Instructions:_

##
1.   Preheat your oven to 200 degrees.  
2.   In a large roasting pan, mix the popcorn and pretzels together, then set aside.  
3.   Combine the corn syrup, brown sugar, butter and salt in a saucepan.  
4.   Cook the syrup mixture over medium heat until it is fully boiling, then continue cooking for roughly 5 minutes.  
5.   Remove the mixture from the heat and stir in the baking soda.  
6.   Pour the syrup over your popcorn and pretzels, then sprinkle the peanuts on top. Stir until all of your popcorn is coated, then bake for 20 minutes.  
7.   Stir the mixture again, and mix in the candy corn and M&Ms.  
8.   Bake for 5 more minutes, then spread the caramel corn onto wax paper and let it cool.

Instead of dishing out store-bought bags of treats this year, these homemade Halloween-themed candies will spice up all of your holiday festivities.
**Peanut Butter Pumpkins**
_What You'll Need:_
*   1/2 cup butter  
*   1 package confectioners' sugar (16 ounces)  
*   1 1/2 cups peanut butter  
*   yellow food coloring  
*   red food coloring  
*   green decorators' icing
_Cooking Instructions:_
1.   Melt the butter in a bowl, then add a few drops of red and yellow food coloring. It should turn to an orange (or pumpkin) color.  
2.   Stir the peanut butter and sugar into the bowl until the mixture is dough-like.  
3.   Roll the dough into bite-size, pumpkin-shaped balls, then use a toothpick to make ridges in them.  
4.   Add a drop of green icing to the top of your pumpkins to imitate a stem.  
5.   Refrigerate your pumpkins until firm.
**Halloween Caramel Corn**
_What You'll Need:_
*   16 cups popped popcorn  
*   1 cup butter  
*   5 cups miniature pretzels  
*   2 cups brown sugar  
*   1/2 cup dark corn syrup  
*   1/2 teaspoon salt  
*   1/2 teaspoon baking soda  
*   1 cup candy corn  
*   1 cup salted peanuts  
*   1 M&Ms
_Cooking Instructions:_
texts.29:

1.   Preheat your oven to 200 degrees.  
2.   In a large roasting pan, mix the popcorn and pretzels together, then set aside.  
3.   Combine the corn syrup, brown sugar, butter and salt in a saucepan.  
4.   Cook the syrup mixture over medium heat until it is fully boiling, then continue cooking for roughly 5 minutes.  
5.   Remove the mixture from the heat and stir in the baking soda.  
6.   Pour the syrup over your popcorn and pretzels, then sprinkle the peanuts on top. Stir until all of your popcorn is coated, then bake for 20 minutes.  
7.   Stir the mixture again, and mix in the candy corn and M&Ms.  
8.   Bake for 5 more minutes, then spread the caramel corn onto wax paper and let it cool.

Tips for Driving in the Rain
Driving in the rain can be dangerous if you're not careful or if you are but fellow drivers are not. If you just picked up a certified pre-owned vehicle from Mike Albert Sales & Service, you definitely don't want to get into a crash, so that means not only do you need to watch your own driving during the rain, but you need to watch others. Watching others is always a good idea, but even more important in a rain storm.
**Slow Down**
The most important tip for driving in the rain is to slow down. So many people don't slow down and that causes hydroplaning, which will cause accidents. Remember that the speed limit is for ultimate conditions. It is expected that all drivers will slow speeds down when the weather is bad, including rain, fog, snow, sleet and ice.
**Acceleration**
When the roads are wet, don't accelerate hard. You could spin the tires, and if you get enough tire spin, you could lose control, especially if you drive an older vehicle that doesn't have traction control. You'll also save money on fuel economy if you accelerate only as hard as you need to. Heavy acceleration just to slow down for a vehicle in front of you just decreases gas mileage and is dangerous in most conditions, but especially when the roads are slippery.
**Braking**

Some vehicles have speed-sensitive wipers and rain-sensing wipers. They help you manage your wipers when the volume of rain changes. If your vehicle does not have these features, be sure to change the wiper speed so that it's fast enough to keep the windshield clear while you are driving. Title: J.D. Power: Social Media Impacting Purchase Decisions for All Generations
Chunks: 0,1
Westlake Village, Calif. — Social media plays a critical role in driving consumer purchase and service decisions across all generational groups in the automotive marketplace, according J.D. Power and Associates’ recently released 2014 Social Media Benchmark Study.
Now in its second year, the study measures the overall consumer experience in engaging with companies through their social media platforms for both marketing and servicing needs across 30 U.S. automotive brands.
Marketing engagements include connecting with consumers to build brand awareness and affinity, as well as communicating about products and promotions. Servicing engagements include answering specific consumer questions or resolving problems. The study establishes quantitative performance benchmarks and industry best practices that provide automakers and dealers with insights to help them maximize their social media efforts.
“Auto manufacturers that focus just on reaching Millennials through social media are missing a tremendous opportunity, as social media is a channel that reaches all generations of consumers,” said Arianne Walker, senior director of automotive media & marketing, J.D. Power. “Today, for the first time, we have an in-depth understanding of what helps drive satisfaction in social media interactions across generations, and not just among consumers who are highly engaged in social media, but also those who are more casually engaged with a brand through this channel. It is important to provide a satisfying social media experience for all consumers because it helps drive current and future business.”
According to the study’s findings, consumers who are delighted with their servicing and marketing experiences (satisfaction scores of 901-1,000 on a 1,000-point scale) have a positive impression of the automotive brand and an increased likelihood to repurchase from the same brand in the future. The same goes for consumers delighted with their social media servicing experience and those delighted with their marketing experience.
Additionally, consumers delighted with their social media servicing experience indicate they are more likely to return to the automotive brand dealer for service.
The study also found that one-fifth (20%) of consumers use social media as their primary source of information about automotive brands, while nearly one-third (29%) of social media users get recommendations about a product or service from friends and family exclusively through social media.
The most frequently used social media marketing channel is Facebook (29%), followed by YouTube (19%) and Twitter (11%). The most frequently used social media servicing channel is Facebook (84%), followed by Twitter (34%) and YouTube (25%).

Toyota ranked highest among automotive brands, with a score of 845. Ford ranked second with a score of 842, followed by Chevrolet at 838. The industry average was 824.
The 2014 Social Media Benchmark Study is based on responses from more than 9,800 U.S. online consumers who have interacted with a company via that its social media channel. The study was fielded from Nov. 18, 2013, through Feb. 9, 2014.
The overall Social Media Benchmark Index is comprised of the Social Media Marketing Index and the Social Media Servicing Index, each representing 50 percent of the overall score. The overall index measures consumers’ social media experiences across marketing and servicing interactions.
